Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 45 McGill Street Precinct 45

Clause 9.45.1 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): The McGill Street precinct is located in the Lewisham industrial area.

Clause 9.45.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): This precinct has been identified as having high biodiversity values. It is essential that development within the precinct considers the potential impacts to biodiversity including native fauna (including Threatened Species and Endangered Populations); native vegetation (including Endangered Ecological Communities); and habitat elements (including their condition, structure, function, connectivity and disturbance).

Clause 9.45.3 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): accommodating mixed use development of high to medium densities and scales.

Clause 9.45.3 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): The precinct will accommodate some minor service retail, commercial offices and showrooms as well as studio, cafe and restaurant spaces.

Clause 9.45.3 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To ensure that new development considers all potential impacts to biodiversity.

Clause 9.45.3 - development_control (development_control): To ensure that higher density development demonstrates good urban design and environmental sustainability and provide suitable amenity for occupants of those developments.

Clause 9.45.3 - development_control (development_control): To ensure that the design of higher density development protects the residential amenity of adjoining and surrounding properties.

Clause 9.45.4 - heritage (development_control): There are no Heritage Conservation Areas contained within the precinct.
